data.name: Jaahiliyyaat
data.gender_notes: Jaahiliyyaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A term used in Islamic history to refer to the period before the advent of Islam in Arabia, characterized by ignorance, lawlessness, and immorality. The name Jaahiliyyaat carries the meaning “Pre-Islamic” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jaahiliyyaat usually hope their child will grow to embody pre-islamic and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the importance of following the true path of Allah and avoiding the pitfalls of ignorance and immorality.
data.etymology: Jaahiliyyaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pre-Islamic.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaahiliyyaat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.long_meaning: الجاهليّة هو مصطلح يصف العصر قبل الإسلام، حيث كانت المجتمعات العربية غائبة عن العقلانية والدين، وتعني الجاهليّة الفترة الزمنية التي كانت قبل الإسلام، وهي الفترة التي كان فيها العرب مشغولين بالشعر والغنا والقتال، وتعني كذلك العصر الذي كان فيه العرب بعيدين عن المعرفة والدين والتقدم

in_english.name: Jaahiliyyaat
in_english.meaning: Jaahiliyyaat refers to the pre-Islamic era
in_english.long_meaning: Jaahiliyyaat refers to the pre-Islamic era, a time when Arab society was absent of intellect and religion, it refers to the period before Islam, also known as the time when Arabs were far from knowledge and religion, and also refers to the era of ignorance and disbelief, and it is used to describe the period before the revelation of the Quran and the prophethood of Muhammad.
